source_text: Tigna domorum nostrarum cedrina, laquearia cypressina. Domus Dei ecclesia est; tigna apostoli et prophetae; laquearia ordines sanctorum. Cedrus imputribilis: doctrina incorrupta. Cypressus odorem habet et altitudinem: vita redolens et ad caelum tendens.
pass_a_gloss: Beams of-houses our cedar, paneling cypress. House of-God church is; beams apostles and prophets; paneling orders of-saints...
pass_b_english: [[The beams of our houses are cedar, our paneling cypress >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:17]]. God’s house is the church; the beams apostles and prophets; the paneling the orders of the saints. Cedar is incorruptible: uncorrupted teaching. Cypress has fragrance and height: a life that is fragrant and tends toward heaven.
